name: Sakaide (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Sakaide city emblem in white: two stacked stylised birds with outstretched wings.
history: Municipal flag of Sakaide, a city in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1942.

features.role: Sakaide city emblem — two stacked stylised birds with outstretched wings
